emma (docs): spotted mismatch in quickstart: curl uses REDWOOD_API_KEY but TS sample references REDWOOD_API_TOKEN — causing auth errors.
liam (devex): paste the two snippets?
emma (docs): curl:
```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'```
emma (docs): ts sample:
```const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN });```
sofia (engineer): that's leftover from rename. should be REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere.
liam (devex): also add note for PowerShell quoting.
sofia (engineer): suggested change: ts -> apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY; add footnote: Windows PowerShell use $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY and double quotes.
nate (product): customer onboarding hit. recommend docs patch ASAP.
emma (docs): opening tiny PR now, tagging @liam for review.
deploy-bot: docs build started (#4902)
liam (devex): reviewed, adjusted PS example: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'```
sofia (engineer): LGTM.
deploy-bot: docs build passed (#4902) ✅
emma (docs): merged; scheduling immediate deploy :tada:
liam (devex): adding changelog entry about env var parity and PS gotchas.
sofia (engineer): can we add a docs smoke test that renders both curl and sdk blocks and asserts same env var name?
emma (docs): will follow up with smoke test PR.
liam (devex): closing when smoke test merges.
